content.short: ZK Stack provides a zK rollup framework with full sovereignty for the data availability layer, gas tokens, and sequencing.
content.description: The ZK Stack is developed under free open-source licenses and is available at no cost. Contributions and use are encouraged. zkSync Era is a Layer-2 protocol that scales Ethereum with cutting-edge ZK tech. zkSync Era aims to increase Ethereum's throughput while preserving its foundational values—freedom, self-sovereignty, and decentralization—at scale.
